arguments.Title: 실제 운송 예약 보호 확인
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { var c=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<UnityAutonomousClient>(); if(c==null||!c.TransportReserved){result.Log("NOT_RESERVED");return;} bool before=c.IsDriving; c.StartMission("main_gate_road_candidate"); result.Log("reserved="+c.TransportReserved+" driving_before="+before+" driving_after="+c.IsDriving+" target="+c.LastTargetSpeedKmh+" result="+c.MissionResult); ScreenCapture.CaptureScreenshot("artifacts/high_speed_drive/request-ui-running.png"); } }
